settings.max-forge-upgrades.label: Max Forge Upgrades
settings.max-forge-upgrades.tooltip: Sets the maximum number of times a weapon can be upgraded at the forge. (Vanilla 3)
settings.max-forge-per-gem.label: Max Forge Level Per Gem Type
settings.max-forge-per-gem.tooltip: Sets the maximum number of times a weapon can be upgraded at the forge with a game of the same type. (Vanilla 3)
settings.cinder-shards.base.label: Base Upgrade Cost
settings.cinder-shards.base.tooltip: Sets the base number of cinder shards to upgrade a weapon. (Vanilla 10)
settings.cinder-shards.scaling.label: Upgrade Scaling Amount
settings.cinder-shards.scaling.tooltip: Sets the number of additional cinder shards required per level to upgrade. (Vanilla 5)
